title: Test runs: one at a time, or in parallel
question: Agents test the game in a headless browser. A rule from yesterday lets only one run at a time, so agents queue for up to an hour. Should runs go in parallel when the machine has room?

options.label: Parallel when there's room
options.note: Each run gets its own lock; a run only waits if the machine's load is above its 32 cores. About 5 or 6 runs fit at once. Your pick here is also the permission I need: the safety check blocked me from changing the shared lock without it.

options.label: Keep one at a time
options.note: No change. Slow, but the machine stays quiet.
